prompt: A ride supervisor at the Gullwing Pier observation wheel filed a fault. The wheel carries 30 cabins, numbered 0 through 29, and the numbering rolls over, so cabin 0 rides directly behind cabin 29. Overnight crews closed an arc of cabins for re-glazing, from cabin 26 to cabin 3, and cabin 1 sits inside that closed arc. Even so, isCabinInArc(1, 26, 3) in src/cabin-arc.mjs returned false, and the gate let riders board cabin 1 with its glass still masked off. Fix isCabinInArc in src/cabin-arc.mjs so an arc that rolls over past cabin 0 is read correctly. The regression command is `npm test`: it fails on this case now and should pass after the fix.
